about: R-BENCHMARK final export: Training Board kit sprites (B2), Tower Climb room icons (B4), final tab icons (B3). Sizes are 1x points; every file also exists as name@2x.png. nineSlice = [top, right, bottom, left] in 1x px (same as menu2.json).
rule: No text in any sprite except the 師 seal glyph. Orange = ENTER THE TOWER only. No red anywhere in the UI. Guardian/boss is purple.
menu2RefsNote: These already exist in incoming-art/menu2/sprites (A-MENU2). Not copied here. The Board uses them as they are.

climbRooms.note: RoomKind also has "practice". It has NO icon here (only five were approved). Use the battle icon or ask Art for a sixth.

kit/button-enter.note: ENTER THE TOWER button (the only orange in the UI). Text cream with an orange-brown outline. 3-slice along x only (left and right caps 28 px, middle column stretches). Height is fixed at 44 pt. Text is drawn by the game.

kit/button-enter-pressed.note: ENTER THE TOWER, pressed (2 pt lower, short shadow). Move the text down 2 pt. 3-slice along x only (left and right caps 28 px, middle column stretches). Height is fixed at 44 pt. Text is drawn by the game.

kit/button-gold.note: Gold lacquer main action (Climb again). Text dark ink #462a16. 3-slice along x only (left and right caps 28 px, middle column stretches). Height is fixed at 44 pt. Text is drawn by the game.

kit/button-gold-pressed.note: Gold, pressed. Move the text down 2 pt. 3-slice along x only (left and right caps 28 px, middle column stretches). Height is fixed at 44 pt. Text is drawn by the game.

kit/button-wood.note: Wood button for secondary actions (Practice room, back to Dojo). Text cream with a dark shadow. 3-slice along x only (left and right caps 28 px, middle column stretches). Height is fixed at 44 pt. Text is drawn by the game.

kit/button-wood-pressed.note: Wood, pressed. 3-slice along x only (left and right caps 28 px, middle column stretches). Height is fixed at 44 pt. Text is drawn by the game.

kit/button-wood-disabled.note: Wood, disabled (locked). Text colour #bea07c. 3-slice along x only (left and right caps 28 px, middle column stretches). Height is fixed at 44 pt. Text is drawn by the game.

kit/tab-normal.note: Wood tab, resting. Top of the shape is 8 pt below the active tab. 3-slice along x (20 px caps). Open at the bottom: the tab sits on the frame. Icon and label are drawn by the game.

kit/tab-pressed.note: Wood tab, pressed (darker). 3-slice along x (20 px caps). Open at the bottom: the tab sits on the frame. Icon and label are drawn by the game.

kit/tab-active.note: ACTIVE tab: raised honey-gold lacquer, 4 pt taller. Draw it 4 pt higher than the others. Label dark ink #462a16. 3-slice along x (20 px caps). Open at the bottom: the tab sits on the frame. Icon and label are drawn by the game.

kit/new-dot.note: Small gold "something new" dot. No number, never red. Sits at the tab's top-right: (tabLeft + tabWidth - 20, tabTop).

kit/paper-card.note: Cream paper card with a wood edge: the one paper tone on every tab. 9-slice 18 px (6 shadow + 10 corner + 2).

kit/ribbon-rooted.note: Rooted family ribbon (blue). Small bookmark flag with a notched tail. 3-slice along x: 14 px left cap, 24 px right cap (the notch).

kit/ribbon-flowing.note: Flowing family ribbon (green). Same shape and slice.

kit/medallion-lit.note: Gate lock seal, lit: gold with a check. Diameter 38 pt. One per lock that is lit.

kit/medallion-locked.note: Gate lock seal, locked: wood with a paper padlock. Diameter 38 pt.

kit/sensei-seal-unlit.note: Sensei's Seal, not lit yet: paper stamp with the 師 character (master) in muted brown. Diameter 64 pt.

kit/sensei-seal-lit.note: Sensei's Seal, lit (Sensei says you are ready): gold with the 師 in dark brown. Cross-fade from unlit over about 0.3 s.

kit/level-fill-gold.note: Level bar fill, gold-tinted. Frame = menu2 xp-bar-frame (see menu2Refs). Draw the fill 4 pt inside the frame, width = (frameWidth - 8) * fraction, 11 pt tall. 3-slice along x, 6 px caps. Gloss = menu2 xp-bar-gloss on top.

kit/floor-mat.note: Tatami floor mat the hero stands on (flat oval). Hero feet at the middle of the mat.

wall/wall-844x390.note: The wood wall behind every tab, one image at the 844 x 390 design size. Scale to cover. Vertical planks every 58 pt.

tab-icons/tab-icon-climb.note: B3 final climb tab icon, 26 pt box. Dark outline so it reads on the wood tab and on the gold active tab. No red.
